issues: Panel rows and cards are all grey skeleton bars with nothing readable, so you can't tell what got placed on the canvas
The left canvas is a large empty area with no title or context; the settled frame isn't a poster
Rows start morphing the moment they lift, with position and size interpolating together, so there's no weight
The cursor only walks to the button at the end; the checkboxes tick on their own, so the causality is unclear
changes: Sand paper look with a terracotta accent: a Fieldnote "Highlights" panel lists five research highlights (32px titles, author avatars) beside a discussion board with an 84px serif title "Q3 discovery"
The cursor clicks three checkboxes like a real user (terracotta ticks spring in and draw on), then presses "Add to board"; the button count bumps with each tick

Each row lifts for 4f (2% scale, deeper shadow), then flies a quadratic arc in a staggered sequence; position leads and size settles 3f later, with directional motion blur and a shadow that grows with height
Cards land at −2.5/1.8/−1.2° with a 6f squash; the card form is a publication-grade insight card (tag, serif title, quote, author) and vacated rows collapse into terracotta dashed "On board" slots
After landing, "3 highlights pinned" rises beside the board title and the camera pushes in 2.5%; 130→150f
